text: The analysis checked for fire detections using data from four satellites: **VIIRS S-NPP**, **VIIRS NOAA-20**, **VIIRS NOAA-21**, and **MODIS**. These sensors were monitored from **October 4, 2026, to November 3, 2026**, covering the entire period. No fire detections were found intersecting the asset during this time. The data was sourced from NASA FIRMS, which provides near real-time active fire and thermal anomaly detections.
